verdict.rationale: Wave ships several fixed, built-in background automations: recurring invoices with automatic card billing, scheduled overdue reminders at 3/7/14 days (Pro), auto-import and categorization of bank transactions (Pro), and automatic payroll tax payment and filing. However, these are preset feature toggles rather than user-defined, agentic automations, and the public pages document no workflow builder, webhooks, API, or AI-agent surface. Missing for 10: user-configurable or custom automation rules/workflows, AI-driven autonomous actions, webhook/API triggers, independent hands-on corroboration.
